newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-CENTRE VAN SCHALKWYK WITHDRAWS FROM SPRINGBOK SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CENTRE VAN SCHALKWYK WITHDRAWS FROM SPRINGBOK SQUAD.

text.p: Centre Danie van Schalkwyk has withdrawn from the South African squad to tour Argentina, France and Wales next month forcing a fifth change to the original team.

Van Schalkwyk broke into the Springbok side this season but pulled up in pain with a recurring groin injury during practice on Tuesday. The Northern Transvaal player has been ordered to rest the injury.
Natal's Dick Muir, who played impressively in his province's Currie Cup triumph on Saturday, will replace van Schalkwyk.
The experienced Muir, who has represented the Springboks at sevens rugby, is the third Natal player to be added to the original selection.

His provincial centre partner Jeremy Thomson was called up to replace Christiaan Scholtz while prop Adrian Garvey was drafted in for Os du Randt. Other original selections to drop out are wing Pieter Hendriks and utility back Boeta Wessels, who have been replaced by Justin Swart and Joe Gillingham.
The party leaves for the five test tour on Thursday morning.
